nativeGuidance.childRoutes: CupertinoPageRoute; keep native interactive back gesture
nativeGuidance.rootTabs: persistent tab navigators/state; crossfade content, animated selection pill
nativeGuidance.motion: peopi-motion.tokens.json; use a shared service/widgets, not screen-local timings
nativeGuidance.accessibility: MediaQuery.disableAnimations and accessibleNavigation; Reduce Transparency where supported
nativeGuidance.prototypeBoundary: Web motion is a behavioral reference; native physics, keyboard, focus, permissions, backend and security must be implemented and device-tested.

rules: Start invisible; show no individual pins, identities or exact coordinates. Display subtle aggregated activity zones only.
Feature marketing-oriented blurred map backdrop with central beacon ripples, floating intent speech bubble, and aggregated activity indicators.
Show up opens session setup; it does not start sharing yet.
validation: Rapid repeated taps resolve to the final state without ghost screens.
Back/dismiss restores context; tab switches preserve state.
Reduce Motion uses opacity only; focus and content remain usable.
closed.uiRecipe: Marketing-forward blurred map landing with concentric pulsing wave ripples, profile preview with floating intent speech bubble, subtle aggregated activity zones, completion surface and primary Show up action. Keeps individual identities private until session is active.
motionNotes: Discover tab crossfades in place; concentric beacon wave rings pulse gently without distracting from primary action.
Speech bubble floats subtly; reduced motion switches to static state.
Show up pushes Start session; nothing is shared until Go visible is confirmed.

rules: Allow one networking intent and bounded session durations (30 min, 60 min default, or 120 min). No arbitrary custom durations.
Only explicit Go visible starts a session after permission checks.
Cancel returns to Closed without broadcasting.
validation: Rapid repeated taps resolve to the final state without ghost screens.

setup.uiRecipe: One scrolling setup flow. Rounded intent choices, 30/60/120 min duration preset cards with check indicators, Go visible then Not now. No custom duration inputs. No fixed overlapping footer.
motionNotes: Pure horizontal push transition preserves full surface opacity without text collision.
Intent and duration chips use press feedback; the selection commits instantly.
Go visible returns to the active map; Not now pops back to the invisible state.

motionNotes: Map/List switch crossfades the content; the selection capsule slides.
Nearby people appear as one group fade, never card by card.

Privacy beacon radiates continuous 3.6s expanding radar waves, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules: Read one canonical profile model; calculate completion from real fields.
Use approved identity/photo; editing opens a child route.
Preserve profile scroll when switching tabs.
Profile strength means completeness, not trustworthiness or verification. Expose its value as accessible progress.
Use a light raised identity card (theme-aware), with avatar, name, 15 pt headline and 13 pt approximate city.
Use 15–17 pt main content and 13–14 pt supporting text; allow native text scaling and wrapping.
Show profile strength as one short row and a thin progress bar, with one 46 pt Edit profile action. No repeated edit links or privacy badges.
Group About, intent and skills in rounded 22 pt surfaces with subtle shadows; use a rounded privacy menu row with 62 pt minimum height.
Keep copy concise without truncating user-authored biography or changing visibility rules. Profile card itself is not tappable.
Display user work experience (Title, Company, Country, Dates) in a dedicated section with direct edit link.
Display user documents and portfolio attachments (CV/Resume, Cover Letter, One Pager) in a connection-only section with a direct edit link.

presentation.typography: Main content 15–17 pt; supporting copy 13–14 pt; text inputs 16 pt; preserve text scaling and full user content.
presentation.surfaces: Theme-aware rounded groups, 22–26 pt radius, subtle shadows, spacing rather than repeated divider lines.
presentation.copy: One useful explanation per decision; remove repetition, keep privacy/trust/demo boundaries.
presentation.navigation: 70 pt floating nav inset 16 pt; bottom fade begins 30 pt above nav top (116 pt from viewport bottom).
presentation.behavior: Visual modernization must not change consent, session, connection, chat, privacy or verification state.
